skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Valiant General
skins.content: Striker Series/Valiant General. A product of Raythean Industries, this traditional Victorian formal attire has been reworked with upgraded materials across the board, alongside a lining imbued with the latest in structured textiles, providing effective protection against sharp instruments.
skins.quote: Civilization asks that people dress appropriately, but oftentimes, it takes the good old rules of nature to settle an incident.
